# Bizagi Raises $48m in Funding

[![FinSMEs](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/9693e37a896f29b3764ec27c2e558735?s=96&d=mm&r=g)](https://www.finsmes.com/author/admin "FinSMEs")

![](https://www.finsmes.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/bizagi.jpg)[**Bizagi**](http://www.bizagi.com/), a London, UK-based enterprise software company, raised $48m in funding.

Private equity firm Invus made the investment.

The company will use the new capital to accelerate growth across focus markets – the US and Europe.

Founded in 1989 by Gustavo Gomez, CEO, Bizagi provides digital process automation software used by large businesses to connect people, applications, devices and information to deliver engaging experiences.

Customers include adidas, Aon plc, Old Mutual and Kaiser Permanente, among others.

The company now employs over 400 people with global headquarters in the UK and regional offices across Europe, US and Latin America.
